title: Analytics models
responsibility: Separates model authorship from evaluation and presents recorded usage and first-try results.

inputs.name: AnalyticsModels.models
inputs.description: Required analytics model summary with check/loop author counts, evaluator counts/tokens and per-author first-try figures for response and clean-code checks. Names, including unknown, are preserved.

outputs.name: AnalyticsModels
outputs.description: Role-separated usage cards, token totals and author first-try table. Usage bars scale to the largest count. A zero assessed denominator displays an unavailable rate regardless of its stored rate, with excluded/check counts kept visible. Empty categories are stated explicitly. Does not recompute which checks count as assessments.
